governance: Week 0/1 observations are opponent/context adjusted and layered on top of preseason priors. No system-level weights changed. Team/unit deltas remain deliberately capped after one or two games; blowouts versus weak opponents and turnover-driven score margins are discounted.

teams.evidence: Held TCU to 10 points and shut down the run after halftime; 322 total yards on offense.
Only 10 points; 11 penalties for 100 yards and a lost fumble materially hurt the result.
Outgained NC State 413-168 and rushed for 258 yards; Beau Pribula produced efficiently as passer and runner.
Only 168 yards and 84 passing yards in a 34-8 loss; broad pregame absence list tempers the downgrade.
Controlled FBS debut 33-7; one score came from an opponent snap error, so the update is capped.
Seven points and little sustained offense at NDSU; one-game opponent-quality uncertainty remains high.
Week 0 passing upgrade was not confirmed against San Jose State; EMU lost 27-21 at home after closing as a small favorite. Return prior upgrade toward neutral rather than overreacting.
257 total yards, 13 first downs and two turnovers in FBS debut; small move only.
Week 0 offensive optimism was sharply challenged by a 45-6 loss at Miami. Opponent quality is high, so prior Stanford upgrade is mostly removed rather than converted into a large downgrade.
Followed the Stanford loss with only six points against UNLV. Passing-upside thesis remains but has not translated; cap downgrade because weather/travel and opponent context matter.
419 yards and strong red-zone execution, but allowed efficient passing and did not separate enough to justify an overall upgrade.
Trey Hedden was efficient through the air but the Aggies managed only 47 rushing yards.

Added 335 rushing yards and 42 points against Arkansas State after a strong Week 0. Four opponent interceptions inflate margin, so overall upgrade rises only 0.25 from prior despite dominant rushing production.
Defense held Hawaii to six points, offsetting part of Week 0 late-down concern. Offensive ceiling remains unproven enough to avoid a positive overall move.
A 39-0 win over Fresno State with only 116 yards allowed materially improves the defensive read after Week 0 leakage; opponent adjustment keeps the net overall move modest.
Won 27-21 at Eastern Michigan after scoring 26 at USC. Two-game offensive competence is more meaningful than the Week 0 game-state-only signal, but upgrade remains capped.
Beat Wyoming 35-13 as Hauss Hejny threw five touchdowns and the defense produced three interceptions. Turnover assistance prevents a larger overall upgrade.
Allowed 35 points and five passing touchdowns at Colorado State; offensive output remained limited. One-game rivalry context caps the downgrade.
Needed a last-second Hail Mary to beat Western Michigan 13-12 and committed three turnovers. Strong preseason prior prevents a larger move.
Lost 24-10 to Tulsa in a high-transition opener. New-regime volatility is already in the prior, so downgrade is capped despite a poor result.
Beat Boise State 34-27 behind 378 passing yards but did not dominate the scoreboard. Treat as confirmation of offensive ceiling rather than overall upgrade.
Played Oregon within seven on the road. Quality-opponent performance earns a small positive adjustment, not a major move from one game.
Outgained Indiana 367-365 despite losing 52-16; score was distorted by red-zone failure and game-state. Preserve overall prior while flagging finishing efficiency.
Produced 671 yards in a 56-7 win with Kalieb Osborne contributing as passer and runner, but 10 penalties for 134 yards and opponent quality temper the upgrade.
Beat Oregon State 33-20; OL and inactive-player context plus missed tackles keep the upgrade small.
Lost 33-20 at Houston. Road/opponent context argues for only a small downgrade ahead of Texas Tech.
Rushed for 465 yards in a 31-3 win over HCU. Competition level heavily discounts the overall move while preserving a run-game unit signal.
Won 45-16 with three Owen McCown touchdown passes but allowed UTRGV more than 400 yards. Opponent adjustment prevents an overall upgrade.
Beat Texas State 59-7 with four Arch Manning passing TDs and multiple takeaways. Large talent gap requires aggressive opponent discounting.
Beat Ball State 56-3; dominant but expected, so only a small confirmation update ahead of Texas.
Beat Clemson 51-10 in a high-quality matchup. This is stronger confirmation than a buy-game blowout, but one result still cannot drive a system-wide reweight.
Lost 51-10 to LSU. Opponent quality and preseason OL uncertainty were already known, so downgrade is capped.
